features.visitor_job: Understand the three different guide wings, the research hold, local-device boundary and what can be used before choosing a route.
features.environment_object: The luminous nave, votive register and research-status lectern.
features.result: A truthful orientation to wing jobs, content availability, current local picks and next action
features.desktop: The nave leads directly into one visible register and three doors without a generic dashboard detour.
features.mobile: Orientation and status remain before the vertically recomposed doors; no feature depends on the hero crop.
features.accessibility: All status and scope are DOM text; the no-script state stays fail-closed and supplies safe return routes.
features.growth_behavior: Wing counts and admitted availability come from content/status contracts while the nave remains the stable spatial shell.
features.new_feature_behavior: A genuinely new guide class receives a named door or alcove with its own job and admission state, not another card section below the hall.
features.preview_contract: Before entering a wing, visitors can tell the wing's job, item count, held/admitted state and that choices are device-local.
features.opened_experience: The visitor remains in the hall and deliberately opens one wing rather than landing in an unexplained profile grid.

features.visitor_job: Choose between memorable pop-culture moves, sourced historical contributors and current builders without hunting through the page.
features.environment_object: Three labelled stained-glass wing doors in the nave.
features.result: Exactly one matching wing panel opens in place with URL/hash, expanded state and a clear close/change path
features.desktop: Three door objects share one sightline and reveal the selected wing immediately beneath them.
features.mobile: Full-width doors stack with complete labels/counts; the selected panel follows its controlling door without image-map precision.
features.accessibility: Native buttons expose names, aria-controls and aria-expanded; focus styling and reduced-motion behavior are explicit.
features.growth_behavior: Each wing owns a data-driven archive/roster and overflow pattern, so more guides do not require more nave doors.
features.new_feature_behavior: A new wing is added only when its visitor job cannot truthfully live in an existing archive alcove.
features.preview_contract: Each closed door names the wing, explains its contents, shows quantity/availability and says Enter before activation.
features.opened_experience: The door becomes Close and reveals the real wing in context; back/hash behavior preserves the visitor's place.

features.visitor_job: Know what a guide contributes, the scope and freshness of the claim, and its source before relying on or opening the full account.
features.environment_object: A portrait plaque in a wing, with a source/freshness marker and profile reverse or archive modal.
features.result: An admitted scoped account and exact source, or an explicit held/corrected/retired state with no unsupported profile
features.desktop: Portrait plaques occupy their wing and open a readable reverse/modal without abandoning the hall.
features.mobile: Profile content reads continuously in a closeable sheet/modal; it does not imitate page flips or require tiny portrait taps.
features.accessibility: Only admitted cards become named keyboard controls; modal focus wraps, Escape/backdrop close and focus returns to the opener.
features.growth_behavior: Claim/profile records and archive alcoves accept more people while keeping stable selectors, source envelopes and browse structure.
features.new_feature_behavior: A new profile format needs an exact content schema, source/freshness treatment and accessible result surface before admission.
features.preview_contract: The visible plaque states identity, why the guide is here, held/admitted status and expected detail/source result before opening.
features.opened_experience: The account is a readable sourced museum label/profile, not a decorative card flip that hides essential content.

features.visitor_job: Choose, change or clear one admitted guide per wing and understand the choice is private same-browser preference, not ownership or achievement.
features.environment_object: A votive/candle control attached to an eligible guide and the three-place votive register in the nave.
features.result: Read-back-confirmed saint, maven or trailblazer preference on this device, with visible clear/change and failure truth
features.desktop: The control remains attached to the guide and the nave register reflects all three choices.
features.mobile: Named controls and register text remain operable without relying on candle imagery or hover.
features.accessibility: Buttons expose selection state and status announcements; failed storage cannot announce success.
features.growth_behavior: Versioned admitted-roster validation permits more guides while retaining one slot per wing and safe invalidation.
features.new_feature_behavior: Account sync, rewards or additional slots require separate identity/economy authority and cannot grow from localStorage semantics.
features.preview_contract: Before choosing, the control says which local slot changes and that it stays in this browser/device.
features.opened_experience: Selection updates the votive in place and leaves the profile/wing available for continued reading.

features.visitor_job: Resume locally explored MAiVEN material without mistaking an opened count for learning, mastery, reward or public identity.
features.environment_object: The MAiVENS archive index and private opened-here register.
features.result: One archive alcove opens and eligible profile-open history updates as private device-local context
features.desktop: The archive rail changes one chamber inside the MAiVENS wing and keeps progress language visibly bounded.
features.mobile: The alcove rail is a labelled tab sequence with one continuous panel, not an ever-growing portrait grid.
features.accessibility: Tabs expose selected state and controlled panels; the register is status text and never relies on colour.
features.growth_behavior: New admitted profiles enter an existing collection or paged/filterable archive collection without expanding the nave.
features.new_feature_behavior: A new historical collection receives a named alcove in the archive index only after its scope and browse job are defined.
features.preview_contract: Each alcove names the collection before opening; profile availability remains subject to exact claim admission.
features.opened_experience: Visitors browse one coherent archive chamber and read profiles continuously, with an obvious route back to other alcoves.

features.visitor_job: Hear an exact rights-cleared guide anthem intentionally, with readable context and a reliable pause/error path.
features.environment_object: An anthem button on the guide plaque and the KSVL-owned player mechanism.
features.result: Explicit play/pause of the admitted guide track or an accessible held/network/decode error with profile text preserved
features.desktop: Audio remains a secondary object attached to its guide; profile/source reading is never hidden by playback.
features.mobile: Large named play/pause controls remain adjacent to the guide and do not autoplay.
features.accessibility: The button exposes exact action/track context and current playing state; readable content remains a complete fallback.
features.growth_behavior: Tracks come only from the admitted KSVL registry so roster expansion cannot bypass rights or player lifecycle.
features.new_feature_behavior: Playlists, narration or video need their own admitted media identity and accessible player result.
features.preview_contract: The button identifies the guide's song and play action before activation; unavailable tracks are held rather than presented as playable.
features.opened_experience: Playback occurs through one persistent accessible player while the visitor stays on the guide.

features.visitor_job: See whether correction intake is actually available and, when verified, report an affected claim without a false delivery or reply promise.
features.environment_object: The research-status lectern and its Town Hall correction notice.
features.result: Town Hall preflight/status or a future authoritative submission receipt carrying safe affected-claim context
features.desktop: The correction route remains beside research status and relevant profile context.
features.mobile: The status and named route stay readable before navigation; no tiny badge or hidden menu is required.
features.accessibility: Link text and surrounding status distinguish preflight from submission; button success can never establish delivery.
features.growth_behavior: Stable claim IDs and a shared Town Hall lifecycle support more profiles without per-profile forms.
features.new_feature_behavior: Public comments, replies or moderation are separate community products and cannot be inferred from correction intake.
features.preview_contract: Before leaving, visitors know the destination, current preflight state and that no submission/reply is yet promised.
features.opened_experience: Town Hall owns the intake and receipt; return/propagation reconnects to the exact affected LUMINAiRY claim.

features.visitor_job: See the same valid local guide choices on the Resident Card/Closet surface and return to change them at their source.
features.environment_object: The votive register and the hall's signposted route to Your Luminaries in the Closet.
features.result: The same three valid device-local preferences on the consumer surface, or an honest missing/removed state with a return route
features.desktop: The future exit sign belongs to the nave register rather than a generic footer recommendation grid.
features.mobile: A named text-equivalent route must remain adjacent to the register and preserve the correct return destination.
features.accessibility: The route must name destination and purpose; no local preference may be announced as account-backed identity or ownership.
features.growth_behavior: One versioned producer/consumer selection contract supports roster expansion and safe removal across both buildings.
features.new_feature_behavior: Cross-device sync, public profile or collection mechanics require approved identity/privacy contracts and separate controls.
features.preview_contract: Before navigating, visitors know Closet will reflect current device-local choices and will not create an account or public profile.
features.opened_experience: Closet displays the same valid names with a direct return to the producing wing for change/clear.

current_blockers: All 46 substantive production claim blocks and the current portrait references remain held; atomic source, rights, freshness and independent signed admission are required before real profiles open.

The three door environment is locally implemented, but its current stained-glass/portrait art is implementation evidence only and the 15 inventoried portrait uses are DO NOT ADMIT pending approved successors.
The KSVL anthem handoff lacks exact rights/public proof and must fail closed when a track is held, removed, missing or undecodable.

The in-room Closet exit and device-local producer/consumer initial-change-clear-unknown round trip are locally verified, but owner/native/public proof, correction lifecycle and all account-backed continuity remain unproved.
Native Safari/VoiceOver/zoom, human newcomer comprehension, exact release identity and public-origin verification remain open.
